action_queue_display_par_message.uiLocation: Action queue progress display, parallel group message

action_queue_display_fiat_sell_message.uiLocation: Action queue progress display, fiat sell step message

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code of the asset being sold

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code of the borrowed asset

bitpay_metadata_name.description: Note saved on a transaction paid through a BitPay invoice. It records the invoice ID for the user's later reference in transaction details.

placeholders.%s: BitPay invoice ID

bitcoin_received.description: Message in the dropdown banner shown when an incoming transaction is detected in one of the user's wallets. Despite the key, it is used for any currency.

placeholders.%1$s: Formatted received amount with symbol and denomination name, such as ₿ 0.001 BTC

boot_failed_message_1s.description: Error text shown on a full screen when the app cannot start up because of a fatal error.

placeholders.%1$s: Error message describing why startup failed

dialog_title.description: Title of the modal where the user chooses how long the app can be idle before it logs them out automatically.

share_subject.description: Subject line and title of the share sheet when the user shares the app with a friend from the side menu. It reads like a personal recommendation.

placeholders.%s: App name, such as Edge

share_message.description: Body text of the share sheet when the user shares the app with friends from the side menu. It is a short marketing blurb describing the app, sent along with a referral link.
share_message.uiLocation: Side menu, Share app action (system share sheet message)

drawer_borrow_dollars.description: Side menu item, shown only when beta features are enabled, that opens the loans feature where the user borrows fiat dollars against their crypto.

drawer_exchange_rate_loading.description: Status text meaning the exchange rate (crypto-to-fiat price) is still being fetched. No usage sites found, so the meaning is inferred from the key; it was likely shown in the side menu or a rate display.

drawer_exchange.description: Side menu item label for the exchange feature, where the user swaps one cryptocurrency for another. No usage sites found; meaning inferred from key.

drawer_scan_qr_send.description: Side menu item that opens the camera to scan a QR code, such as a payment address or request, to start sending crypto.

drawer_sweep_private_key.description: Title of the scene that completes sweeping a private key, meaning moving all funds from an external private key into the user's wallet. Also the name of the corresponding side menu action.

drawer_fio_names.description: Side menu item that opens the list of the user's FIO names (FIO crypto handles and domains).

drawer_fio_requests.description: Side menu item that opens the list of FIO payment requests the user has sent or received.

drawer_gift_cards.description: Side menu item label for buying or managing gift cards. No usage sites found; meaning inferred from key.

network_alert_title.description: Error message shown when the device has no internet connection, for example when the connection drops, when sending logs, or when selecting a wallet while offline.
network_alert_title.uiLocation: Error toast/alert (network status, send logs, wallet list modal)

fio_network_alert_text.description: Error shown when the user tries a FIO action (such as registering a FIO handle or loading FIO addresses) while offline, because FIO needs an internet connection.

fio_domain_choose_label.uiLocation: FIO Domain Register scene, domain input modal title

fio_address_choose_domain_label.uiLocation: FIO Address Register scene, domain row; Domain list modal title

scan_qr_label.description: Title of the camera scanning modal where the user scans a QR code, used from the side menu, WalletConnect connections, and the send address field.

settings_debug_info_servers.uiLocation: Debug scene, per-wallet nodes section sub-heading

settings_debug_custom_servers.description: Sub-heading above a JSON box listing servers that the user added manually. Shown in the Debug scene.
settings_debug_custom_servers.uiLocation: Debug scene, per-wallet nodes section sub-heading

settings_debug_user_settings.description: Sub-heading above a JSON box showing the user's settings for a wallet's currency plugin, shown in the Debug scene.
settings_debug_user_settings.uiLocation: Debug scene, per-wallet nodes section sub-heading

settings_debug_network_config.description: Sub-heading above a JSON box showing the network configuration of a wallet's currency plugin, shown in the Debug scene when such data exists.
settings_debug_network_config.uiLocation: Debug scene, per-wallet nodes section sub-heading

settings_debug_no_wallets.description: Empty-state message shown in the expanded Nodes & Servers section of the Debug scene when the account has no wallets.

settings_debug_info_log.description: Sub-heading for the Info log in the Debug scene logs section; tapping expands it. Also used as the name of the copied data in the confirmation toast.

settings_debug_activity_log.description: Sub-heading for the Activity log in the Debug scene logs section; tapping expands it. Also used as the name of the copied data in the confirmation toast.

settings_debug_no_logs.description: Empty-state message shown in an expanded log box in the Debug scene when there are no log entries.

settings_debug_info_log_dev.description: Message shown in the Info Log box of the Debug scene when the app runs a development build, where the log is not collected. __DEV__ is the code's development-mode flag and should stay untranslated.

settings_debug_long_press_hint.description: Hint at the top of the Debug scene telling the developer that long-pressing a section header copies its contents to the clipboard.
settings_debug_long_press_hint.uiLocation: Debug scene, hint text at top

settings_debug_copied_1s.description: Toast confirming that debug data was copied to the clipboard after a long press. It names what was copied.

placeholders.%1$s: Name of the copied item, such as 'Info Log', 'Nodes & Servers' or a wallet section label

settings_verbose_logging.description: Switch row in Settings that turns on verbose (detailed, info-level) logging of app activity, useful for troubleshooting.

settings_theme.description: Title of the modal where the user picks the app's appearance theme (light, dark or system).

settings_theme_light.description: Option in the theme picker for the light color appearance of the app.

settings_theme_dark.description: Option in the theme picker for the dark color appearance of the app.

settings_theme_system.description: Option in the theme picker that makes the app follow the device's system-wide light or dark setting.

button_disable_animations.description: Switch row in Settings that turns off animations in the app.

settings_button_contacts_access_permissi.description: Switch row in Settings controlling whether the app may access the device's contacts, for example to fill in names on addresses.

settings_button_lock_settings.description: Settings row shown while account settings are unlocked. Tapping it locks the sensitive account settings (password, PIN, username, etc.) so they can't be changed without unlocking.

settings_button_password_recovery.description: Settings row that starts setting up password recovery, a way to regain access to the account if the password is forgotten.

settings_button_logout.description: Side menu item that logs the user out of their Edge account.

settings_button_pin.description: Settings row that lets the user change the PIN used to quickly log in to their account.

settings_exchange_settings.description: Title of the screen, and the Settings row leading to it, for configuring exchange (swap) providers. Shown only when swaps are enabled.
settings_exchange_settings.uiLocation: Settings scene row / Exchange settings header

settings_exchange_instruction.description: Instruction text at the top of the exchange settings screen, explaining that the user can turn individual swap (crypto exchange) providers on or off.

settings_marketing_notifications_switch.description: Switch row in notification settings to enable or disable receiving marketing (promotional) push notifications.

settings_price_notifications_switch.description: Switch row in notification settings to enable or disable push alerts about cryptocurrency price changes.

settings_hide_spam_transactions.description: Switch row in Settings that hides transactions identified as spam (such as unsolicited token transfers) from transaction lists.

settings_default_screen_title.description: Inferred from the key: title of a setting that lets the user choose which screen the app shows first after logging in.

settings_default_screen_home.description: Inferred from the key: option in the default-screen choice that makes the Home screen appear after login.

settings_default_screen_assets.description: Name of the 'Assets' option for the default screen the app opens to. It refers to the screen listing the user's crypto assets (wallets and tokens). No usage sites were found, so this is inferred from the key.

settings_developer_options_force_la.description: Label of a developer-only toggle in Settings that forces new accounts to be created as light accounts (accounts without a username or password). It appears only when developer mode is on.
settings_developer_options_force_la.uiLocation: Settings scene, developer options switch row

swap_preferred_header.description: Title of the modal where the user picks which exchange provider is preferred for swaps. It also serves as the section header above the preferred-exchange row in swap settings.
swap_preferred_header.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, preferred exchange modal title and section header

swap_preferred_cheapest.description: Option meaning the app automatically chooses the swap provider offering the best price. Shown as a choice in the preferred exchange list and as the current selection in the swap settings row.
swap_preferred_cheapest.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, preferred exchange row and modal list

swap_preferred_dex.description: Option meaning the user prefers decentralized exchanges (DEXs) when several providers can fill a swap. Shown in the preferred exchange list and as the current selection.
swap_preferred_dex.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, preferred exchange row and modal list

swap_preferred_cex.description: Option meaning the user prefers centralized exchanges (CEXs) when several providers can fill a swap. Shown in the preferred exchange list and as the current selection.
swap_preferred_cex.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, preferred exchange row and modal list

swap_options_header_decentralized.description: Section header above the list of decentralized swap providers. The second line, after the line break, explains that using them needs no personal information.
swap_options_header_decentralized.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, decentralized exchanges section header

swap_options_header_centralized.description: Section header above the list of centralized swap providers. The second line, after the line break, warns that these providers may ask for personal information.
swap_options_header_centralized.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, centralized exchanges section header

swap_preferred_instructions.description: Instruction text above the preferred exchange row in swap settings. It introduces the choice the user makes for which provider wins when several can fulfill a swap.
swap_preferred_instructions.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, sub-header above preferred exchange row

swap_preferred_promo_instructions.description: Instruction text shown in swap settings when an active promotion forces a specific swap provider. It appears above a row that lets the user remove the promotion.
swap_preferred_promo_instructions.uiLocation: Swap settings scene, sub-header when a promotion controls the swap provider

swap_token_no_enabled_exchanges_2s.description: Error message saying no enabled swap providers currently support the given token on the given network. Shown as a toast on the swap screen, or as an error on the send screen when a swap is needed.
swap_token_no_enabled_exchanges_2s.uiLocation: Swap create scene toast and Send scene swap error

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code of the token, e.g. USDC
placeholders.%2$s: Display name of the blockchain network the token is on, e.g. Ethereum

swap_minimum_receive_amount.description: Row label shown on a swap quote next to the smallest amount the user is guaranteed to receive. The crypto and fiat amounts appear beside it.

swap_price_impact_warning_title.description: Title of a warning card on the swap confirmation screen, shown when the swap rate is much worse than the market rate. 'Price impact' means how much the trade moves the price against the user.
swap_price_impact_warning_title.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, warning card title

swap_price_impact_warning_body.description: Body of the warning card on the swap confirmation screen, telling the user the swap rate is much less favorable than the current market rate.
swap_price_impact_warning_body.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, warning card body

swap_price_impact_fee_warning_title.description: Title of the warning card on the swap confirmation screen, shown when both a high price impact and high fees apply. It has the same wording as the price-impact-only title.
swap_price_impact_fee_warning_title.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, combined warning card title

swap_price_impact_fee_warning_body.description: Body of the combined warning card on the swap confirmation screen. It says the rate is much worse than the market rate and that high network fees relative to the swap amount contribute.
swap_price_impact_fee_warning_body.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, combined warning card body

swap_minimum_amount_1s.description: Short label on a swap provider row showing the minimum amount the user will receive from that provider's quote.
swap_minimum_amount_1s.uiLocation: Swap provider row in the quote list

placeholders.%1$s: Formatted minimum crypto amount to receive, without the currency symbol

settings_button_clear_logs.description: Action to delete the app's stored log files. It is the label of a button in Settings and the title of the confirmation modal that follows.
settings_button_clear_logs.uiLocation: Settings scene button and Clear Logs confirmation modal title

send_to_1s.description: Button label in the logs modal that sends the log file to the app's support team. The placeholder is the app name.

placeholders.%1$s: App name, e.g. Edge

settings_button_export_logs.description: Action to export the app's log files so the user can share them, for example with support. It is a Settings button label and also the title, subject and message of the system share sheet.
settings_button_export_logs.uiLocation: Settings scene button and Logs modal share sheet

settings_button_setup_two_factor.description: Row in account settings that opens the setup flow for two-factor authentication (2FA), an extra login security step.
settings_button_setup_two_factor.uiLocation: Settings scene, account section tappable row

settings_button_unlock_settings.description: Row label shown when sensitive account settings are locked. Tapping it prompts the user to authenticate to unlock settings such as password and username.

settings_button_use_touchID.description: Label of the toggle for logging in with Apple's Touch ID fingerprint on iOS. It is also the initial default text before the biometric type is detected.
settings_button_use_touchID.uiLocation: Settings scene, biometric login switch row

settings_button_use_faceID.description: Label of the toggle for logging in with Apple's Face ID on iOS devices that support it.
settings_button_use_faceID.uiLocation: Settings scene, biometric login switch row

settings_button_use_biometric.description: Generic label of the toggle for logging in with biometrics (such as fingerprint or face unlock) on Android devices.
settings_button_use_biometric.uiLocation: Settings scene, biometric login switch row

settings_days.description: Unit name for days, used when setting the auto-logout time. It appears as an option in the unit picker and after the number in the auto-logout row (e.g. '3 Day(s)'). The '(s)' covers singular and plural.
settings_days.uiLocation: Auto logout modal unit picker and Settings auto-logout row

settings_denominations_title.description: Section header above the list of denominations for a currency, i.e. the units used to display amounts (for example BTC, mBTC or bits). Shown only when a currency has more than one.

settings_custom_nodes_title.description: Title of the setting that lets users use their own servers (nodes) for a currency instead of the default ones.
settings_custom_nodes_title.uiLocation: Currency settings scene, custom servers setting header

settings_custom_servers_title.description: Title of the custom servers setting for a specific server type, such as Electrum or Blockbook.
settings_custom_servers_title.uiLocation: Currency settings scene, custom servers setting header

placeholders.%s: Server type name, e.g. Electrum or Blockbook

settings_blockbook.description: Name of the Blockbook server type, a blockchain indexing backend. It is used as a technical name inserted into the custom servers title and is normally not translated.
settings_blockbook.uiLocation: Currency settings scene, custom Blockbook servers setting

settings_electrum.description: Name of the Electrum server type, a protocol used by Bitcoin-like wallets. It is used as a technical name inserted into the custom servers title and is normally not translated.
settings_electrum.uiLocation: Currency settings scene, custom Electrum servers setting

settings_monero.description: Header of the Monero settings section for choosing the Light Wallet Server (LWS) that scans the blockchain for the user's Monero transactions.

settings_monero_edge_lws.description: Radio option to use Edge's own Monero Light Wallet Server (LWS). It is also shown as the current value in the wallet settings summary.
settings_monero_edge_lws.uiLocation: Monero settings radio row and Wallet settings modal

settings_monero_custom.description: Radio option to use a Monero Light Wallet Server chosen by the user. If a server is set, its address is appended after a colon and line break.

settings_monero_custom_lws.description: Short value shown in the wallet settings summary when the Monero wallet uses a custom Light Wallet Server (LWS) instead of Edge's.
settings_monero_custom_lws.uiLocation: Wallet settings modal, server backend summary

settings_monero_edge_lws_imported_wallet.description: Error or warning explaining that Edge's Light Wallet Server can't be used with imported Monero wallets. The user must choose a custom LWS or a full node instead.
settings_monero_edge_lws_imported_wallet.uiLocation: Monero settings error and wallet settings warning

settings_monero_lws_info.description: Explanatory text in the Monero settings. It says Edge uses Light Wallet Servers (LWS) to scan for transactions and that users can run their own for better privacy.
settings_monero_lws_info.uiLocation: Monero settings, sub-header above LWS options

settings_monerod.description: Header of the Monero settings section for choosing the monerod server, the full node software the wallet connects to.

settings_monerod_edge_full_node.description: Radio option to use Edge's own Monero full node (monerod). It is also shown as the current value in the wallet settings summary.
settings_monerod_edge_full_node.uiLocation: Monero settings radio row and Wallet settings modal

settings_monerod_custom_full_node.description: Radio option to use a Monero full node (monerod) chosen by the user. If a server is set, its address is appended after a colon and line break. It is also the summary value in wallet settings.
settings_monerod_custom_full_node.uiLocation: Monero settings radio row and Wallet settings modal

settings_network_privacy_title.description: Header above a group of radio options where the user chooses how the app connects to the network (standard or via the Nym mixnet) for a given currency.
settings_network_privacy_title.uiLocation: Currency settings, network privacy section header

settings_network_privacy_default.description: Radio option for the standard network connection, where the user's IP address is not hidden from servers.
settings_network_privacy_default.uiLocation: Currency settings, network privacy radio row

settings_network_privacy_nym_mixnet.description: Radio option that routes the currency's network traffic through the Nym mixnet, a privacy network. Nym is a product name.
settings_network_privacy_nym_mixnet.uiLocation: Currency settings, network privacy radio row

settings_privacy_settings.description: Tappable row in Settings that opens the privacy settings scene; also the title of that scene.
settings_privacy_settings.uiLocation: Settings scene options row and Privacy Settings scene title

settings_nym_mixnet_title.description: Section header on the Privacy Settings scene above the list of currencies that can use the Nym mixnet. Nym is a product name.

settings_nym_mixnet_warning_title.description: Title of a warning card shown while sending or staking, telling the user the Nym mixnet is active for this transaction.
settings_nym_mixnet_warning_title.uiLocation: Send scene and Stake Modify scene, warning card title

settings_nym_mixnet_warning_body.description: Body of a warning card explaining that privacy routing through Nym means the transaction may take a minute or more before it is broadcast.
settings_nym_mixnet_warning_body.uiLocation: Send scene and Stake Modify scene, warning card body

settings_nym_multi_asset_warning_title.description: Title of a confirmation modal shown when the user enables the Nym mixnet for more than one asset, warning about performance.
settings_nym_multi_asset_warning_title.uiLocation: Privacy Settings toggle / network privacy confirm-continue modal title

settings_nym_multi_asset_warning_body.description: Body of the confirmation modal warning that using the Nym mixnet on several assets simultaneously can slow sending and delay balance updates.
settings_nym_multi_asset_warning_body.uiLocation: Confirm-continue modal body, shown when enabling Nym on multiple assets

settings_nym_mixnet_description.description: Explanatory text at the top of the Privacy Settings scene describing the Nym mixnet, its privacy benefits and its slowdown tradeoffs, and prompting the user to pick which services use it via the toggles below.

settings_hours.description: Unit label for hours, used as a choice in the auto-logout time unit picker and next to the number in the Settings auto-logout row (e.g. "2 Hour(s)"). The (s) indicates singular or plural.
settings_hours.uiLocation: Auto Logout modal unit list and Settings scene auto-logout row

settings_minutes.description: Unit label for minutes, used as a choice in the auto-logout time unit picker and next to the number in the Settings auto-logout row. The (s) indicates singular or plural.
settings_minutes.uiLocation: Auto Logout modal unit list and Settings scene auto-logout row

settings_modal_export_logs_warning.description: Warning shown in the export logs modal, telling the user not to type sensitive data such as seeds, private keys or passwords into the notes field.

settings_modal_export_logs_directions.description: Instruction in the export logs modal explaining that the user can either share logs with Edge support or export them to their device.

settings_modal_clear_logs_message.description: Confirmation question asking whether the user really wants to delete all stored logs on this device.

settings_modal_clear_logs_success.description: Toast message confirming that all logs were deleted from the device.

settings_modal_send_logs_success.description: Toast message confirming that the logs were successfully sent to Edge.

settings_modal_send_logs_failure.description: Error text saying that sending logs to Edge failed. It is used as a prefix to an error code in the error message.
settings_modal_send_logs_failure.uiLocation: Export Logs modal, error message when sending fails

settings_modal_send_logs_clock_error.description: Error shown when the logs server rejects an upload because the device's date and time are incorrect, advising the user to enable automatic date and time and retry.

settings_modal_share_logs_failure.description: Error message saying that sharing (exporting) logs to another app or location failed. Currently no usage sites were found.

settings_modal_send_unsafe.description: Warning explaining that the logs appear to include sensitive data like private keys and addresses, so sending them to Edge servers is blocked for safety.
settings_modal_send_unsafe.uiLocation: Export Logs modal, warning card footer

settings_modal_send_logs_label.description: Placeholder text in the text field where the user can type optional notes to accompany the logs.
settings_modal_send_logs_label.uiLocation: Export Logs modal, notes text input placeholder

settings_options_title_cap.description: Section header in Settings for the group of general options such as privacy, swaps, auto logout and currency.

settings_seconds.description: Unit label for seconds, used as a choice in the auto-logout time unit picker and next to the number in the Settings auto-logout row. The (s) indicates singular or plural.
settings_seconds.uiLocation: Auto Logout modal unit list and Settings scene auto-logout row

settings_title_auto_logoff.description: Label of the Settings row for how long the app can be inactive before the user is automatically logged out. The chosen time is shown on the right.

settings_title_currency.description: Label of the Settings row for choosing the default fiat currency (e.g. USD) used to display values. The selected code is shown on the right.
settings_title_currency.uiLocation: Settings scene, default currency row label

settings_title_pin_login.description: Label of a toggle in Settings that enables logging back in with a PIN instead of the full password after the app locks.
settings_title_pin_login.uiLocation: Settings scene, PIN re-login switch row

settings_title.description: The name of the Settings area of the app, shown as a menu item in the side menu that opens the settings screen.

settings_enable_custom_nodes.description: Label of a toggle that turns on use of user-specified custom servers (nodes) for a currency's network connection.
settings_enable_custom_nodes.uiLocation: Currency settings, custom servers switch row

settings_add_custom_node.description: Label of a row the user taps to add a new custom server (node) address for a currency.
settings_add_custom_node.uiLocation: Currency settings, custom servers list, add row

settings_edit_custom_node.description: Title of the modal where the user edits the address of a custom server (node), used for both general custom servers and the Monero light wallet server.
settings_edit_custom_node.uiLocation: Edit custom server text input modal title

settings_custom_node_url.description: Label of the text field where the user enters the URL of a custom server (node).
settings_custom_node_url.uiLocation: Edit custom server modal, input field label

settings_promotion_affiliation_header.description: Header of the promotion settings scene about the affiliate/referral program through which the app or account was acquired.

settings_promotion_header.description: Section header above the list of promotion codes the user has applied to their account.
settings_promotion_header.uiLocation: Promotion Settings scene, promotion codes section header

settings_promotion_add.description: Label of a row the user taps to enter and add a new promotion code.

settings_promotion_device_normal.description: Status line saying the app was installed in the ordinary way, not through any referral or affiliate link.

settings_promotion_device_installer.description: Status line saying the app was installed through a particular referral or affiliate source.

placeholders.%s: Name or ID of the affiliate/referral source that the app was installed through

settings_promotion_device_currencies.description: Status line listing the currencies for which wallets will be automatically created in new accounts because of the referral.

placeholders.%s: Comma-separated list of currency codes (e.g. BTC, ETH)

settings_promotion_account_normal.description: Status line saying the account was created in the ordinary way, not through any referral or affiliate source.

settings_promotion_account_installer.description: Status line saying the account was created through a particular referral or affiliate source.

placeholders.%s: Name or ID of the affiliate/referral source the account was created through

settings_notifications.description: Title for the notifications feature: the settings row that opens notification settings, the side menu entry that opens the notification center, and the header of those scenes. Refers to push notifications and alerts, not a single message.
settings_notifications.uiLocation: Settings scene row, side menu item, and notification scene headers

settings_currency_notifications_percent_.description: Label of a toggle in the currency price notification settings. When on, the user is alerted if a coin's price changes by the given percentage within one hour.
settings_currency_notifications_percent_.uiLocation: Currency notification settings scene, hourly change switch row

placeholders.%1$s: Percentage threshold number (e.g. 3). The following %% is a literal percent sign.

settings_currency_notifications_percent_.description: Label of a toggle in the currency price notification settings. When on, the user is alerted if a coin's price changes by the given percentage within the given number of hours.
settings_currency_notifications_percent_.uiLocation: Currency notification settings scene, daily change switch row

placeholders.%1$s: Percentage threshold number (e.g. 10). The following %% is a literal percent sign.
placeholders.%2$s: Number of hours in the time window (e.g. 24), always plural

skip.description: Action to skip a step without doing it. Appears as a link on the getting started intro slides to skip the introduction, and as a secondary button in the two-factor (OTP) reminder modal to decline enabling it for now.
skip.uiLocation: Getting started scene skip link; OTP reminder modal button

staking_change_add_header.description: Scene header for staking: the user chooses to stake (lock up) a cryptocurrency to earn returns. Shown on the stake options scene and the FIO stake scene.
staking_change_add_header.uiLocation: Stake options scene header; FIO staking change scene header

placeholders.%s: Currency code of the asset being staked (e.g. FIO)

staking_change_add_amount_title.description: Title of an editable row where the user sees and taps to enter how much of the coin they want to stake (lock up for returns).
staking_change_add_amount_title.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, amount row (stake)

staking_change_explaner1.description: Explanatory paragraph shown when staking, telling the user that staking their coins earns passive income (returns without further effort).
staking_change_explaner1.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, stake explainer text

staking_change_explaner2.description: Explanatory warning paragraph shown when staking: coins that are staked cannot be spent or moved while the stake lasts.
staking_change_explaner2.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, stake explainer text

staking_change_remove_header.description: Scene header for unstaking: the user withdraws previously staked coins so they stop earning and become available again.

placeholders.%s: Currency code of the asset being unstaked (e.g. FIO)

staking_change_remove_amount_title.description: Title of an editable row where the user sees and taps to enter how much of their staked coin to unstake (withdraw from staking).
staking_change_remove_amount_title.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, amount row (unstake)

staking_change_remove_unlock_date.description: Row title for the date on which unstaked funds become unlocked and usable again. Tapping the row opens an explanation.
staking_change_remove_unlock_date.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, unlock date row (unstake)

staking_change_unlock_explainer_title.description: Title of an info modal explaining funds that have been unstaked but are still locked for a waiting period.
staking_change_unlock_explainer_title.uiLocation: FIO unstake unlock date explainer modal title

staking_change_unlock_explainer1.description: First paragraph of the unlock info modal: funds the user just unstaked cannot be used right away. Ends with a trailing space because it is followed by the next paragraph.
staking_change_unlock_explainer1.uiLocation: FIO unstake unlock date explainer modal body

staking_change_unlock_explainer2.description: Second paragraph of the unlock info modal: unstaked funds stay locked and unspendable for 7 days after unstaking.
staking_change_unlock_explainer2.uiLocation: FIO unstake unlock date explainer modal body

staking_discover.description: Label of the first option in a two-way switch on the Earn scene, showing available staking options the user can discover and join. The other option is Portfolio.

staking_earning_pools.description: Section header above the list of staking pools in which the user can earn returns on their crypto.

staking_earn_crypto.description: Title of a tile on the home screen that leads to staking, where the user can earn returns on their crypto.

staking_earn_crypto_footer.description: Short tagline under the Earn Crypto home tile, saying that staking crypto gives passive returns (income without active effort).

staking_overview_header.description: Header of the FIO staking overview scene, showing the user's staking position for the given currency. 'Stake' here is used as a noun/title for the staking area.

placeholders.%s: Currency code of the staked asset (e.g. FIO)

staking_overview_explainer.description: Introductory line above a list of the user's currently staked and locked amounts. It ends with a colon because the amounts follow.
staking_overview_explainer.uiLocation: FIO staking overview scene, explainer text

staking_portfolio.description: Label of the second option in a two-way switch on the Earn scene, showing the user's own current staking positions. The other option is Discover.

staking_locked_title.description: Title of a row listing an amount of funds that were unstaked but remain locked until a given date and time.
staking_locked_title.uiLocation: FIO staking overview scene, locked funds list row

placeholders.%1$s: Formatted unlock date and time

staking_unstake_funds_button.description: Button that starts withdrawing the user's staked coins from staking.
staking_unstake_funds_button.uiLocation: FIO staking overview scene, bottom button

staking_status.description: Status line on a wallet's transaction list showing how much of the balance is locked in staking, with its fiat value in parentheses.
staking_status.uiLocation: Transaction list header, staking status box

placeholders.%1$s: Locked crypto amount with currency code (e.g. 10 FIO)
placeholders.%2$s: Fiat value with symbol and fiat currency code (e.g. $5.00 USD)

staking_success.description: Toast message confirming that the user's staking transaction was successfully completed.
staking_success.uiLocation: Toast after staking in FIO staking change scene

staking_unstake_success.description: Toast message confirming that the user's unstaking transaction was successfully completed.
staking_unstake_success.uiLocation: Toast after unstaking in FIO staking change scene

staking_estimated_rewards.description: Row title for the estimated amount of reward (earnings) the user will receive when unstaking.
staking_estimated_rewards.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, unstake card row

staking_estimated_return.description: Line showing the expected yearly return rate of staking, as an annual percentage yield (APY).
staking_estimated_return.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, stake card

placeholders.%1$s: APY percentage including the percent sign (e.g. 5%)

staking_estimated_return_up_to.description: Same as the estimated return line, but used when the rate shown is the maximum possible, so the actual yield may be lower.
staking_estimated_return_up_to.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, stake card

placeholders.%1$s: Maximum APY percentage including the percent sign (e.g. 5%)

staking_no_fio_address_error.description: Error shown when the user tries to stake but has no FIO address (a human-readable FIO blockchain name), which is required for the transaction.
staking_no_fio_address_error.uiLocation: FIO staking change scene, error message

string_value.description: Label for the selected gift card value (face value amount) in the gift card purchase scene.
string_value.uiLocation: Gift card purchase scene, fixed amount row

string_tap_next_for_quote.description: Placeholder hint in the swap amount input telling the user to tap the Next button to get a swap quote. The word "Next" refers to the Next button label.
string_tap_next_for_quote.uiLocation: Swap create scene, amount input placeholder

string_tap_to_edit.description: Placeholder hint in an amount input telling the user to tap the field to edit the amount.
string_tap_to_edit.uiLocation: Swap create scene and flip input placeholder

string_rate.description: Label for the row in the flip input modal that shows the current exchange rate between the crypto asset and the user's fiat currency. The exchange rate value is displayed next to it.
string_rate.uiLocation: Flip input modal, exchange rate row

string_got_it.description: Short acknowledgement button text the user taps to dismiss an informational message or modal, meaning 'I understand'.

exchange_rates_loading.description: Status message shown while the exchange rates for several assets are still being fetched. Plural: refers to multiple rates.

exchange_rate_loading_singular.description: Status message shown while a single exchange rate is still being fetched.

string_master_private_key.description: Menu option in a wallet's options list that lets the user view the wallet's master private key (its seed). Tapping it starts the flow to reveal the secret key.
string_master_private_key.uiLocation: Wallet list menu modal, option row

string_add_edit_tokens.description: Menu option in a wallet's options list that opens the screen for adding new tokens to the wallet or editing existing ones.
string_add_edit_tokens.uiLocation: Wallet list menu modal, option row

string_get_raw_keys.description: Menu option and confirm button for revealing a wallet's raw private keys in unprocessed form. Shown in the wallet options menu and as the submit label of the password prompt that precedes showing the keys.
string_get_raw_keys.uiLocation: Wallet list menu modal, option row; password validation modal submit button

string_raw_keys.description: Title of the modal that displays the wallet's raw private keys as JSON text, shown after the user has verified their password.

string_verify.description: Action label meaning to confirm or check something, such as verifying entered information. No usage sites are known.

title_create_wallet_select_crypto.description: Header of the scene where the user picks which cryptocurrencies or tokens to create wallets for. The user selects one or more from a searchable list.
title_create_wallet_select_crypto.uiLocation: Create wallet, select crypto scene header

title_create_wallet_select_fiat.description: Title for choosing a fiat currency (such as USD or EUR) from a list. Used in the fiat picker modal and in the default fiat setting scene.
title_create_wallet_select_fiat.uiLocation: Fiat list modal title; Default fiat setting scene header

title_change_mining_fee.description: Title of the scene where the user chooses the network (mining) fee level for a transaction, such as low, standard or high.

title_change_password.description: Title of the scene where the user changes their account password. Imperative action phrase.

title_change_pin.description: Title of the scene where the user changes their PIN, the numeric code used for quick login.

title_change_username.description: Title of the scene where the user changes their account username.

title_set_duress_pin.description: Title of the scene where the user sets a duress PIN, a secondary PIN that opens a decoy or limited version of the account when the user is under coercion.

title_create_wallet.description: Header of the scene where the user names a new wallet before creating it (singular). Imperative phrase.
title_create_wallet.uiLocation: Create wallet, edit name scene header

title_create_wallet_from_seed.description: Title for creating a wallet by importing an existing seed (recovery phrase). No usage sites are known.

title_create_wallets.description: Plural 'Create Wallets'. Used as the header of the wallet creation completion scene and as the primary button label on the wallet naming scene that creates the chosen wallets.
title_create_wallets.uiLocation: Create wallet completion scene header; Create wallet edit name scene, primary button

title_export_transactions.description: Title of the scene where the user exports a wallet's transaction history to a file, such as CSV.

title_edge_login.description: Title for the Edge Login flow, where the user approves logging in to a third-party service with their Edge account. No usage sites are known.

title_exchange.description: Noun/verb for swapping one crypto for another. Used as the swap scene title and as the start of a summary line in transaction details such as 'Exchange 1 BTC', followed by the amount and currency.
title_exchange.uiLocation: Swap tab scene title; Transaction details, exchange details row

title_fio_sent_request_details.description: Header of the scene showing details of a FIO payment request that the user sent to someone else.
title_fio_sent_request_details.uiLocation: FIO sent request details scene header

title_fio_address_settings.description: Header of the settings scene for a FIO handle, offering actions to reload (add) bundled transactions and to transfer the handle to another owner.

title_fio_domain_settings.description: Header of the settings scene for a FIO domain, offering actions such as renew, transfer and change visibility.

title_fio_add_bundled_txs.description: Action to buy more bundled transactions for a FIO handle (bundled transactions are a prepaid set of FIO operations). Used as a button in the handle settings and in an error modal that prompts the user to add more.
title_fio_add_bundled_txs.uiLocation: FIO handle settings button; No bundled transactions error modal button

title_fio_renew_domain.description: Row in the FIO domain settings that lets the user renew the registration of their FIO domain before it expires.
title_fio_renew_domain.uiLocation: FIO domain settings scene, tappable row

title_fio_renew.description: Button in the modal warning that a FIO name is expiring or expired, letting the user renew it.

title_fio_make_public_domain.description: Action to make a FIO domain public so anyone can register handles on it. Used as the settings row label and as the title of the confirmation form, shown when the domain is currently private.
title_fio_make_public_domain.uiLocation: FIO domain settings, row and action form title

title_fio_make_private_domain.description: Action to make a FIO domain private so only the owner can register handles on it. Used as the settings row label and as the title of the confirmation form, shown when the domain is currently public.
title_fio_make_private_domain.uiLocation: FIO domain settings, row and action form title

title_fio_transfer_domain.description: Row in the FIO domain settings to transfer ownership of the domain to another FIO account.
title_fio_transfer_domain.uiLocation: FIO domain settings scene, tappable row

title_fio_transfer_address.description: Button in the FIO handle settings to transfer ownership of the FIO handle (a human-readable crypto address like name@domain) to another account.

title_fio_address.description: Plural name for the list of the user's FIO crypto handles (human-readable addresses like name@domain). Also reused after 'No' to build an empty-list message such as 'No FIO Crypto Handles'.
title_fio_address.uiLocation: FIO handle list scene, section title and empty text

title_fio_names.description: Button label on the FIO handle registered success scene that opens the list of the user's FIO names (handles and domains).

title_fio_domains.description: Plural name for the section listing the user's FIO domains. Also reused after 'No' to build an empty-list message such as 'No FIO Domains'.
title_fio_domains.uiLocation: FIO list scene, section title and empty text

title_fio_address_confirmation.description: Title for registering a FIO Crypto Handle (a human-readable FIO address). Shown as the header of the registration scenes and saved in the transaction notes.

title_fio_requested.description: Word 'Requested' placed before a currency code on a FIO request row, as in 'Requested BTC', indicating which asset was asked for in the payment request.

title_fio_connect_to_wallet.description: Label for linking a FIO handle to a crypto wallet so the handle can receive funds in that wallet. Used as a row title in registration scenes and as the header of the connect confirmation scene.
title_fio_connect_to_wallet.uiLocation: FIO register scenes, row title; FIO connect wallet confirm scene header

title_fio_disconnect_wallets.description: Row title listing the wallets that will be unlinked from a FIO handle, shown on the connection confirmation scene.
title_fio_disconnect_wallets.uiLocation: FIO connect wallet confirm scene, row title

title_edit_token.description: Header of the scene where the user edits the details of an existing custom token, such as its name, symbol and contract address.

title_add_token.description: Header title of the scene where the user adds a custom token to a wallet. The same scene shows an 'Edit Token' title when editing an existing token.

title_password_recovery.description: Header title of the scene where the user sets up or changes password recovery (recovery questions or recovery by email) for their account.

transaction_details_bought_1s.description: Label for a transaction that was a purchase of crypto through a buy provider. It is an action label like 'Buy Bitcoin', shown in the transaction details or list.

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code or name of the asset that was bought, e.g. BTC

title_select_region.description: Section header above the country/region selector on the buy and sell list. The user picks the country whose payment providers are shown.
title_select_region.uiLocation: Buy/Sell provider list scene, section header

title_select_payment_method.description: Section header above the list of payment methods (such as bank transfer or card) the user can choose for buying or selling crypto.
title_select_payment_method.uiLocation: Buy/Sell provider list scene, section header

transaction_details_sold_1s.description: Label for a transaction that was a sale of crypto through a sell provider. It is an action label like 'Sell Bitcoin', shown in the transaction details or list.

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code or name of the asset that was sold, e.g. BTC

title_otp.description: Header title of the scene for managing two-factor authentication (OTP) on the user's account.

title_register_fio_address.description: Title for registering a FIO address (a human-readable crypto handle). Here it is used at the start of a toast telling the user they must register a FIO address before requesting by FIO address.

title_register_fio_domain.description: Title for registering a FIO domain (the part after the @ in a FIO address). Used as a scene header and as the first line of the transaction note for the registration payment.
title_register_fio_domain.uiLocation: FIO domain registration scenes, header and transaction note

title_settings.description: Header title of the app's main Settings scene.

title_promotion_settings.description: Title of the settings scene for managing promotions and offers, and the label of the row in Settings that opens it.
title_promotion_settings.uiLocation: Settings scene row and Promotion Settings scene header

title_terms_of_service.description: Title of the web view that shows the app's Terms of Service, opened from a row in Settings.
title_terms_of_service.uiLocation: Terms of Service web view, header

title_assets.description: Label of the bottom tab that opens the user's list of wallets and assets.

title_markets.description: Section header on the Home scene above the market prices list, and the side menu item that opens the coin rankings/markets scene.
title_markets.uiLocation: Home scene section header and side menu item

title_wallets.description: Section header above the list of the user's wallets on the wallet list, next to the sort and search buttons.

title_dev_tab.description: Label of a developer-only tab in the bottom tab bar, used for testing. Not shown to regular users.

title_buy.description: Verb for buying crypto. Used as the bottom tab label, as a button label on the coin details scene, and as a button in the price-change notification dialog.
title_buy.uiLocation: Bottom tab bar, coin details action button, price alert dialog button

title_sell.description: Verb for selling crypto. Used as the bottom tab label, as a button label on the coin details scene, and as a button in the price-change notification dialog.
title_sell.uiLocation: Bottom tab bar, coin details action button, price alert dialog button

title_map.description: Label of an optional extra bottom tab that shows a map, such as a map of places that accept crypto. The tab title is configurable per build.

no_exchanges_available.description: Title of an alert shown when the user tries to swap but has disabled every swap provider (exchange) in settings.
no_exchanges_available.uiLocation: No exchanges enabled alert modal, title

check_exchange_settings.description: Message in the alert shown when all swap providers are disabled, telling the user to turn some on in the Exchange Settings.
check_exchange_settings.uiLocation: No exchanges enabled alert modal, message

amount_above_limit.description: Error shown when a swap amount exceeds the maximum the swap provider allows. It states the maximum and warns it may change with market conditions.

placeholders.%1$s: Maximum allowed amount as a number
placeholders.%2$s: Currency code of the asset, e.g. BTC

amount_below_limit.description: Error shown when a swap amount is less than the minimum the swap provider allows. It states the minimum and warns it may change with market conditions.

placeholders.%1$s: Minimum allowed amount as a number
placeholders.%2$s: Currency code of the asset, e.g. BTC

no_amount_below_limit.description: Error shown when a swap amount is below the provider's minimum and the exact minimum is unknown. It suggests entering a higher amount or enabling more providers in Settings, Exchange Settings.

no_amount_above_limit.description: Error shown when a swap amount is above the provider's maximum and the exact maximum is unknown. It suggests entering a lower amount or enabling more providers in Settings, Exchange Settings.

trade_currency.description: Button label on the transaction list header that opens a choice to buy, sell or swap the current asset. 'Trade' is a general verb covering all three.

trade_s.description: Title of a modal that lets the user choose to buy, sell or swap a given asset.
trade_s.uiLocation: Trade modal on the transaction list, title

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code of the asset, e.g. BTC

swap_s_to_from_crypto.description: Row title in the trade modal offering to exchange the asset for or from another cryptocurrency.
swap_s_to_from_crypto.uiLocation: Trade modal on the transaction list, swap row

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code of the asset, e.g. BTC

transaction_details.description: Button label on the swap success scene that opens the details of the completed swap transaction.

transaction_details_category_title.description: Field label for the category of a transaction (such as Income, Expense or Transfer) that the user can edit in the transaction details.

transaction_details_payee.description: Label for the person or business that received a payment, used as a contact type in transaction details. Inferred from the key; no usage found.

transaction_details_payer.description: Label for the person or business that made a payment, used as a contact type in transaction details. Inferred from the key; no usage found.

transaction_details_recipient.description: Label for the person receiving funds. Shown in transaction details for a sent transaction, and as a field label for the bank account holder's name in bank transfer payment instructions.
transaction_details_recipient.uiLocation: Transaction details person row; bank transfer info display scene

transaction_details_sender.description: Label for the person who sent the funds, shown in the transaction details of a received transaction.

transaction_details_person_name.description: Heading for the name of the other party in a transaction, built from the role word such as Sender or Recipient, e.g. 'Sender Name'.
transaction_details_person_name.uiLocation: Transaction details scene, person row header

placeholders.%s: Role of the other party, 'Sender' or 'Recipient' (translated)

transaction_details_person_input.description: Title of a modal where the user picks or types a contact for a transaction, e.g. 'Choose a Recipient'.

placeholders.%s: Contact type or role, such as Sender or Recipient (translated)

transaction_details_crypto_amount.description: Row label for the crypto amount of a transaction, e.g. 'Bitcoin Amount'.

placeholders.%s: Name of the cryptocurrency, e.g. Bitcoin

transaction_details_amount_in_fiat.description: Title of the input modal where the user edits the transaction's value in their fiat currency, e.g. 'Amount in USD'.
transaction_details_amount_in_fiat.uiLocation: Transaction details, fiat amount edit modal title

placeholders.%s: Fiat currency code, e.g. USD

transaction_details_amount_current_price.description: Row label showing what the transaction amount is worth in fiat at today's price, as opposed to the price when the transaction occurred.

transaction_details_view_advanced_data.description: Row title in the transaction details that lets the user open the advanced transaction data in a block explorer.
transaction_details_view_advanced_data.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card row

transaction_details_tx_id_modal_title.description: Label for the unique identifier (hash) of a blockchain transaction. Shown as a row title in transaction details and as a field name in exchange details text that is shared or emailed.
transaction_details_tx_id_modal_title.uiLocation: Transaction details scene, ID row; exchange details text

transaction_details_show_advanced_block_.description: Button label that opens a wallet's public key (xpub) or private view key in a web block explorer. Shown in the modal that displays the key, next to a Copy button.
transaction_details_show_advanced_block_.uiLocation: Wallet list menu, public/view key modal button

transaction_history_permission.description: Confirmation question shown when a partner service (e.g. a third-party provider) asks to receive the full transaction history of a wallet. The user answers Yes or No.
transaction_history_permission.uiLocation: Edge provider export transactions permission modal

placeholders.%s: Name of the wallet whose transaction history would be shared

transaction_details_error_invalid.description: Error message shown when the user taps a transaction in the list but the transaction data is missing or invalid, so details cannot open.

sub_category_label.description: Placeholder text in the text field where the user types a sub-category for a transaction, refining the main category such as Expense or Income.

transaction_details_recipient_address.description: Row title for the single address that received the funds in a send that was made through a swap. Shown above the copyable address on the transaction details screen.
transaction_details_recipient_address.uiLocation: Transaction details scene, recipient address row

transaction_details_recipient_addresses.description: Row title (plural) for the address or addresses that received the funds in an ordinary send transaction. Shown above the copyable address list.
transaction_details_recipient_addresses.uiLocation: Transaction details scene, recipient addresses row

transaction_details_exchange_deposit_add.description: Row title for the address of the exchange provider to which funds were sent in a swap-based send. It is where the provider received the user's deposit.
transaction_details_exchange_deposit_add.uiLocation: Transaction details scene, deposit address row

transaction_details_advance_details_head.description: Header title for the advanced details section of a transaction, which groups technical information such as fees, raw bytes and device.
transaction_details_advance_details_head.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details section header

transaction_details_advance_details_fee_.description: Row title for the fee level the user chose when sending (for example high, standard or low).
transaction_details_advance_details_fee_.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, fee setting row

transaction_details_advance_details_devi.description: Row title for the device (such as a hardware wallet or phone) that was used to sign the transaction.
transaction_details_advance_details_devi.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, device row

transaction_details_advance_details_fee_.description: Row title for the network fee rate that was actually applied to the transaction, as opposed to the fee setting selected.
transaction_details_advance_details_fee_.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, fee used row

transaction_details_advance_details_show.description: Tappable text that opens the transaction (or its payment proof) in a web block explorer. Also used as the label of a button on the explorer card.
transaction_details_advance_details_show.uiLocation: Transaction details advanced card; explorer card button

transaction_details_advance_details_raw_.description: Row title for the raw signed transaction data, shown as a hexadecimal string that the user can copy.
transaction_details_advance_details_raw_.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, raw bytes row

transaction_details_advance_details_acce.description: Tappable row that lets the user speed up a pending transaction by resending it with a higher fee. Opens the accelerate modal.

transaction_details_advance_details_txSe.description: Row title for a secret key tied to a transaction (used for privacy coins such as Monero) that can be shared to prove a payment was made.
transaction_details_advance_details_txSe.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, transaction key row

transaction_details_advance_details_paym.description: Row title for a payment proof, which is verifiable evidence that a payment was made to a recipient. Tapping the row opens it in an explorer.
transaction_details_advance_details_paym.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, payment proof row

transaction_details_advance_details_satp.description: Unit label for a Bitcoin-style fee rate, in satoshis per virtual byte of transaction size.
transaction_details_advance_details_satp.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, fee value label

transaction_details_advance_details_gasp.description: Label for the gas price of an Ethereum-style transaction, with the amount expressed in Gwei.
transaction_details_advance_details_gasp.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, fee value label

transaction_details_advance_details_gasl.description: Label for the gas limit, the maximum amount of gas units an Ethereum-style transaction may use.
transaction_details_advance_details_gasl.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, fee value label

transaction_details_advance_details_mine.description: Label for the miner tip (priority fee) of an Ethereum-style transaction, with the amount expressed in Gwei.
transaction_details_advance_details_mine.uiLocation: Transaction details, advanced details card, fee value label

transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.description: Title of the modal that lets the user speed up a pending transaction by resending it with a higher fee.

confirm_finish.description: Button label in a confirmation modal. It appears after the user agrees to the terms, and tapping it confirms and completes the flow.
confirm_finish.uiLocation: Confirm and continue modal, primary button

transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.description: Row title for the network fee of the original transaction, shown beside the new fee in the accelerate modal.
transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.uiLocation: Accelerate transaction modal, old fee row

transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.description: Row title for the higher network fee that will be used when the transaction is resent, shown in the accelerate modal.
transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.uiLocation: Accelerate transaction modal, new fee row

transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.description: Text shown on the confirmation slider when it is disabled because the transaction cannot be accelerated (an error occurred or it is already sending).

Toast confirming that the transaction was successfully resent with a higher fee.
Title of a warning card in the accelerate modal saying that the amount the recipient receives will be reduced.
transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.uiLocation: Accelerate transaction modal, warning card title

transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.description: Warning explaining that, because the balance cannot cover the higher fee, the amount the recipient gets will be lowered in order to accelerate the transaction.
transaction_details_accelerate_transacti.uiLocation: Accelerate transaction modal, warning card body

transaction_details_empty_note_placehold.description: Placeholder shown in the notes row of a transaction when no note has been written. Tapping it lets the user add an optional note.

transaction_details_exchange_details.description: Title of the modal that shows the plain-text details of a swap or fiat exchange, which the user can read or send to support.

transaction_details_exchange_service.description: Field name for the exchange provider (service) that carried out the swap or purchase, used in the exchange details text.

transaction_details_exchange_order_id.description: Field name for the order identifier given by an exchange provider for a swap or purchase. Also used as a label in payment details.
transaction_details_exchange_order_id.uiLocation: Exchange details text; payment info display scene

transaction_details_exchange_source_wall.description: Field name for the wallet that funds were taken from in a swap, used in the exchange details text.
transaction_details_exchange_source_wall.uiLocation: Swap exchange details text, source wallet field

transaction_details_exchange_destination.description: Field name for the wallet that receives the swapped funds, used in the exchange details text.
transaction_details_exchange_destination.uiLocation: Swap exchange details text, destination wallet field

transaction_details_exchange_exchange_ad.description: Field name for the address of the exchange provider to which the user sent funds for the swap, used in exchange details text.
transaction_details_exchange_exchange_ad.uiLocation: Exchange details text, exchange address field

transaction_details_exchange_exchange_un.description: Field name for the unique identifier assigned by the exchange provider to the swap, used in exchange details text.
transaction_details_exchange_exchange_un.uiLocation: Swap exchange details text, unique ID field

transaction_details_exchange_payout_addr.description: Field name for the address to which the exchange provider pays out the converted funds, used in exchange details text.
transaction_details_exchange_payout_addr.uiLocation: Exchange details text, payout address field

transaction_details_exchange_refund_addr.description: Label for the address where a swap provider will send funds back if the exchange fails or is cancelled. Shown in the swap details card and in the exported/emailed exchange data text.
transaction_details_exchange_refund_addr.uiLocation: Swap details card, refund address entry

transaction_details_exchange_status_page.description: Row title for a link to the exchange provider's web page showing the status of the user's swap or fiat order. Tapping it opens the link in a browser.
transaction_details_exchange_status_page.uiLocation: Swap details card and fiat exchange details card, status page row

transaction_details_exchange_support.description: Row title for the exchange provider's support email address. Tapping it opens an email draft to contact the provider about the swap or fiat order.
transaction_details_exchange_support.uiLocation: Swap details card and fiat exchange details card, support row

transaction_details_exchange_support_req.description: Subject line of a pre-filled email the user sends to an exchange provider's support about their order. The provider name is inserted at the start.
transaction_details_exchange_support_req.uiLocation: Support email subject (opened from swap or fiat exchange details card)

placeholders.%s: Display name of the exchange provider (swap or fiat provider)

transaction_details_fee_warning.description: Title of a warning card on the swap confirmation screen telling the user that the network fees for this swap are unusually high.

transaction_details_swap.description: Title for a transaction that is a swap, i.e. exchanging one cryptocurrency for another. Shown as the transaction's name in transaction lists and details.

transaction_details_swap_and_send.uiLocation: Transaction list and transaction details, title

transaction_details_stealth_swap_and_sen.description: Title for a private (privacy-enhanced) transaction that swaps one asset to another and sends it to a recipient. Shown as the transaction name.
transaction_details_stealth_swap_and_sen.uiLocation: Transaction list and transaction details, title

transaction_details_swap_network_fee.description: Label for the blockchain network fee paid as part of a swap. Shown as the name of the fee transaction row.
transaction_details_swap_network_fee.uiLocation: Transaction list and transaction details, swap fee row

transaction_details_swap_order_cancel.uiLocation: Transaction list and transaction details, category/label
