mining_fee.uiLocation: Confirm scene info tile; exchange quote fee row

scan_camera_missing_qrcode.description: Toast shown when the user picks an image from their library to scan and no QR code can be found in it.

scan_camera_permission_denied.description: Message in a modal explaining that camera access is disabled and the user must enable it in the device Settings to scan QR codes.

scan_camera_no_matching_wallet.description: Message telling the user that none of their wallets can handle the link they scanned or opened.
scan_camera_no_matching_wallet.uiLocation: Scan / deep link handling, error message

open_settings.description: Button in a modal telling the user that camera permission was denied. Tapping it opens the phone's system settings for the app so the user can grant camera access.

ss_geolock.description: Error message shown when a swap (currency exchange) cannot be completed because the exchange provider restricts the user's geographic location.

ss_unable.description: Error message shown when getting a swap quote fails because none of the enabled exchange providers support swapping between the two requested currencies.

placeholders.%1$s: currency code of the asset being swapped from (e.g. BTC)
placeholders.%2$s: currency code of the asset being swapped to (e.g. ETH)

ss_same_address_upgrade_created_3s.description: Message in an error modal explaining that this kind of swap upgrade needs both wallets to share the same address, and that a new wallet was automatically created to satisfy this. The user is asked to retry the upgrade.
ss_same_address_upgrade_created_3s.uiLocation: Swap processing scene, error modal message

placeholders.%1$s: currency code of the source asset
placeholders.%2$s: currency code of the destination asset
placeholders.%3$s: name of the wallet that was created

ss_same_address_upgrade_selected_3s.description: Message in an error modal explaining that this kind of swap upgrade needs both wallets to share the same address, and that an existing matching wallet was automatically selected. The user is asked to retry the upgrade.
ss_same_address_upgrade_selected_3s.uiLocation: Swap processing scene, error modal message

placeholders.%1$s: currency code of the source asset
placeholders.%2$s: currency code of the destination asset
placeholders.%3$s: name of the wallet that was selected

account.description: Label for the user's Edge account, the logged-in identity that holds their wallets and settings. The provided sites are mostly tests and type comments, so the exact UI placement is inferred from the key and value.
account.uiLocation: Account label (generic, e.g. settings or account-related rows)

forget_account_title.description: Title of the confirmation modal shown when the user chooses to remove a saved account from this device via the side menu.
forget_account_title.uiLocation: Side menu, forget account confirmation modal title

forget_account_message_common.description: Warning in the forget-account confirmation modal. It explains that removing the account from this device disables PIN login and requires username and password, and that accounts with 2FA need a 2FA code or a waiting period before access is regained.
forget_account_message_common.uiLocation: Side menu, forget account confirmation modal message

placeholders.%1$s: username of the account being forgotten

no.description: Negative answer button 'No' on a yes/no confirmation dialog.

yes.description: Affirmative answer button 'Yes' on a yes/no confirmation dialog, for example when rejecting a FIO request.

swap_terms_accept_button.description: Button that accepts an exchange provider's terms (including possible identity verification) so the user can continue getting quotes from it.
swap_terms_accept_button.uiLocation: Swap verify terms modal, primary button

swap_terms_reject_button.description: Button that rejects an exchange provider's terms, so the user stops receiving quotes from it. Also used as the swipe action label for declining an incoming FIO payment request.
swap_terms_reject_button.uiLocation: Swap verify terms modal, secondary button; FIO request row swipe action

swap_terms_kyc_link.description: Tappable link label that opens the exchange provider's AML/KYC (anti-money-laundering / know-your-customer) policy web page.

swap_terms_privacy_link.description: Tappable link label that opens the exchange provider's privacy policy web page.

swap_terms_terms_link.description: Tappable link label that opens the exchange provider's terms of use web page.

swap_terms_statement.description: Explanatory text in a modal telling the user that an exchange provider may require identity verification, and asking them to review the terms and either tap Accept to continue or Reject to stop receiving quotes from it.

alert_deep_link_no_wallet.description: Alert shown when the user opens a link for a particular currency but has no wallet supporting it. It tells them to create one with the + button on the wallet list screen.
alert_deep_link_no_wallet.uiLocation: Deep link alert (no usage site found)

placeholders.%1$s: name or currency code of the required asset
placeholders.%2$s: name or currency code of the asset to create a wallet for

alert_deep_link_no_wallet_for_uri.description: Error shown when the user opens a link (such as a voucher or payment link) but none of their wallets can handle it.

load_plugin.description: Developer-oriented action to load a plugin from a URL. Used as the modal title and the submit button label.
load_plugin.uiLocation: Plugin list scene, load plugin text input modal (title and submit button)

plugin_url.description: Label of the text field where a developer enters the web address (URL) of a plugin to load.
plugin_url.uiLocation: Plugin list scene, load plugin modal input label

create_wallet_failed.description: Error message saying that creating a new wallet did not succeed. No usage site found.
create_wallet_failed.uiLocation: Wallet creation error (no usage site found)

choose_your_wallet.description: Prompt asking the user to pick one of their wallets. Used as placeholder text on a wallet selector row and as the title of a wallet picker modal.
choose_your_wallet.uiLocation: FIO address/domain registration wallet selection; wallet list modal header

error_creating_wallets.description: Error shown when creating and backing up the initial wallets timed out due to network problems. It asks the user to check the connection and restart the app to retry.
error_creating_wallets.uiLocation: Error message after login/signup wallet creation

error_must_select_state_province_s.description: Toast shown when the user selects a country that requires choosing a state or province, but dismisses the selection without choosing one.

placeholders.%1$s: name of the selected country

edge_login_failed.description: Title of an error modal shown when logging in another device via Edge Login (scanning a QR code) fails.
edge_login_failed.uiLocation: Edge Login scene, error modal title

edge_login_fail_stale_qr.description: Error message explaining that the scanned Edge Login QR code is invalid or expired, and that the user should generate a new QR code on the device they want to log in to and try again.
edge_login_fail_stale_qr.uiLocation: Edge Login scene, error modal message

edge_login_fail_message.description: Error message shown when Edge Login could not reach the network. Asks the user to check their connection and retry.
edge_login_fail_message.uiLocation: Edge Login scene, error modal message

edge_login_fetching.description: Loading status text shown while Edge Login (logging in another device by QR code) information is being retrieved. No usage site found.
edge_login_fetching.uiLocation: Edge Login scene, loading text (no usage site found)

modal_addressexplorer_message.description: Question used as modal title asking whether the user wants to open the displayed address in a block explorer website. The address is shown below as the message.
modal_addressexplorer_message.uiLocation: Request scene, block explorer confirmation modal title

quote_centralized_provider.description: Small subtitle on a swap provider row indicating that the provider is a centralized exchange (as opposed to a decentralized one).

quote_dex_provider.description: Small subtitle on a swap provider row indicating the provider is a DEX (decentralized exchange).

quote_exchange_cost.description: Right-hand column header over the list of swap quotes, shown when the quote is for a target amount. It indicates the amount the user pays (cost) for each quote.
quote_exchange_cost.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, quote list section header

quote_fixed_quotes.description: Section header grouping swap quotes whose rate is guaranteed (fixed) rather than estimated.
quote_fixed_quotes.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, provider list section header

quote_partial_settlement.description: Warning on a swap provider row saying the swap might be only partially completed (partial settlement) with the rest possibly refunded.

quote_payout_amount.description: Label for the amount of crypto the user will receive from a swap or ramp. Shown as a row title in ramp confirmation and as a column heading in the swap quote list.
quote_payout_amount.uiLocation: Ramp confirmation row; swap quote list header

quote_selected_quote.description: Section header for the currently selected swap quote in the list of quotes from exchange providers.
quote_selected_quote.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, provider list section header

quote_swap_provider.description: Title of the modal where the user chooses which exchange provider's quote to use for their swap.
quote_swap_provider.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, provider selection modal title

quote_variable_quotes.description: Section header grouping swap quotes whose final rate is only an estimate and may vary.
quote_variable_quotes.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, provider list section header

quote_requote_toast.description: Brief toast notice telling the user that the swap quote has expired or already been used, and that the app is fetching a new one.

can_be_partial_quote_title.description: Title of an info modal explaining that a swap quote may be only partially filled.
can_be_partial_quote_title.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, partial quote info modal title

can_be_partial_quote_message.description: Warning text in an alert card on the swap confirmation screen, shown when the selected swap quote may only be partly filled. A 'Learn more' button next to it opens a fuller explanation.
can_be_partial_quote_message.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, warning alert card

can_be_partial_quote_with_max_body.description: Body of the explanation modal opened from the partial-fill warning on the swap confirmation screen. It explains that the swap places an order that may be only partly filled, and that the order stays open for a limited time before unswapped funds stay in the source wallet or are returned.
can_be_partial_quote_with_max_body.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, partial quote explanation modal

placeholders.%s: Number of minutes the order stays open (maximum fulfillment time, rounded up)

can_be_partial_quote_body.description: Body of the explanation modal opened from the partial-fill warning on the swap confirmation screen when no time limit is known. It says the swap may fill only part of the order and that unswapped funds stay in the source wallet or are returned.
can_be_partial_quote_body.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, partial quote explanation modal

fixed_quote.description: Label saying the exchange (swap) was done at a fixed quoted rate, as opposed to an estimated one. Shown in the swap and fiat exchange details of a transaction, and included in the shareable text of those details.
fixed_quote.uiLocation: Swap details card and fiat exchange details card, quote type row

estimated_quote.description: Label saying the swap quote is only an estimate and the final amount may differ. Used as the title of a warning card on the swap confirmation screen and as the quote type in swap and fiat exchange transaction details.
estimated_quote.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene warning card title; swap details card and fiat exchange details card

estimated_exchange_message.description: Warning text under the 'Estimated Quote' title on the swap confirmation screen. It tells the user the amount shown is an estimate and they may receive less than quoted.
estimated_exchange_message.uiLocation: Swap confirmation scene, warning alert card body

buy_sell_crypto_select_country_button.description: Prompt asking the user to choose their country or region. It is the placeholder text on the region button when none is selected, and the title of the country list modal that opens from it.
buy_sell_crypto_select_country_button.uiLocation: Buy/sell region button; country list modal title

search_region.description: Label for the search field in the country/region picker modal, where the user types to filter the list of countries.

buy_sell_crypto_select_state_button.description: Title of the modal where the user picks their state (or province) for buy/sell crypto, which can affect which providers are available.

search_states.description: Label for the search field in the state/province picker modal, where the user types to filter the list of states.

buy_sell_crypto_no_provider_region.description: Message shown in the buy/sell crypto provider list when no providers support the user's selected region. It apologizes for the lack of options.
buy_sell_crypto_no_provider_region.uiLocation: Buy/sell crypto plugin list scene, empty state

user_closed_modal_no_wallet.description: Error message used when a third-party plugin asks the user to choose a wallet and the user closes the wallet selection modal without choosing one. It is mainly a developer-facing error returned to the plugin.

plugin_powered_by_space.description: Prefix text meaning a service is provided by a given company, shown before the provider's name (for example 'Powered by Moonpay'). It ends with a space because the name is appended directly after it, so word order and spacing matter.
plugin_powered_by_space.uiLocation: Earn option card, powered-by card and payment method row, provider line

tap_to_change_provider.description: Hint under the 'Powered by' line telling the user they can tap the card to switch to a different swap or service provider.

tap_to_view_quote_amount_and_rate.description: Placeholder shown in a ramp (buy/sell) provider option instead of a quote amount and rate, when the real quote is only available after the user selects the option and opens the provider.
tap_to_view_quote_amount_and_rate.uiLocation: Ramp select option scene, provider quote row

failed_to_calculate_quote_rate.description: Fallback text shown in a ramp provider option when the quote's exchange rate could not be computed.
failed_to_calculate_quote_rate.uiLocation: Ramp select option scene, provider quote body

send_from_wallet.description: Header on the amount entry modal when sending, saying which wallet the funds come from.

placeholders.%s: Name of the wallet the user is sending from

send_to_wallet.description: Header on the Request (receive) scene saying which wallet will receive the funds. The key says 'send to' but the text means receiving into the user's wallet.

placeholders.%s: Name of the wallet that will receive the funds

exchange_slow.description: Message shown on the swap processing screen when finding a swap quote takes longer than usual, asking the user to wait. The line break separates the notice from the 'Please wait' request.

wallet_list_modal_header_parent.description: Section header in a wallet list above the parent wallet, which is the main chain wallet that a token belongs to.

wallet_list_modal_header_mru.description: Section header in a wallet list above the wallets the user used most recently.

wallet_list_modal_header_other.description: Section header in a wallet list above all wallets that are not in the recent list.

wallet_list_modal_header_same_asset.description: Section header in the wallet picker for a transfer between the user's own wallets, above wallets holding the same asset as the source.
wallet_list_modal_header_same_asset.uiLocation: Wallet list modal (self transfer), section header

wallet_list_modal_header_other_assets.description: Section header in the wallet picker for a transfer between the user's own wallets, above wallets holding different assets than the source.
wallet_list_modal_header_other_assets.uiLocation: Wallet list modal (self transfer), section header

wallet_list_modal_creating_wallet.description: Message in a full-screen spinner while a new wallet is being created after the user picks an asset that has no wallet yet.

wallet_list_modal_enabling_token.description: Message in a full-screen spinner while a token is being enabled (or its parent wallet created) so the user can use it.

wallet_list_modal_confirm_s_bank_withdra.description: Message in a confirmation modal explaining that borrowing funds and depositing them straight into a bank account requires a linked bank account with an exchange partner. The Continue button starts linking the account, and the offer is only for US users.
wallet_list_modal_confirm_s_bank_withdra.uiLocation: Wallet list modal, bank withdrawal confirmation modal

placeholders.%1$s: App name (e.g. Edge)

fio_address_first_screen_title.description: Intro headline on the FIO Crypto Handle registration screen, encouraging the user to get an easy-to-remember handle for sending and receiving crypto. A FIO Crypto Handle is a human-readable name like 'name@domain'.
fio_address_first_screen_title.uiLocation: FIO address register scene, intro text

fio_address_features.description: Bulleted list of benefits of a FIO Crypto Handle on the registration screen. Each line begins with a bullet and is separated by a line break.
fio_address_features.uiLocation: FIO address register scene, feature list

fio_address_first_screen_end.description: Explanation on the FIO Crypto Handle registration screen comparing a handle to a website name, saying others can send crypto to it without seeing or using the public key.

fio_domain_reg_text.description: Note on the FIO domain registration screen saying the user needs FIO tokens to register a Crypto Handle on a custom domain.

fio_domain_reg_descr.description: Explanation on the FIO domain registration screen: a Crypto Handle is a username plus a domain, the owner of a custom domain is the only one who can register handles on it, and those registrations are paid with FIO tokens from the wallet that owns the domain.

fio_address_reg_free.description: Button label for registering a free FIO Crypto Handle. No usage was found in the code; meaning is inferred from the key and text.

fio_domain_label.description: Label for a FIO Domain, the part of a Crypto Handle after the @ sign. It is a placeholder in the domain search box, the input label in the domain entry modal, and a name inserted into the pending registration title and message.
fio_domain_label.uiLocation: FIO domain list modal search field; domain input modal; domain registration pending modal

fio_domain_free.description: Tag shown beside a FIO domain in the domain list to mark that registering on that domain costs nothing.
fio_domain_free.uiLocation: FIO domain list modal, row tag

fio_address_payment_required_text.description: Explanation on the wallet selection screen when registering a FIO Crypto Handle. It says the fee is required by the FIO Protocol, not by the app, that each handle includes some free actions with no mining fee, and asks the user to pick a wallet to pay from.
fio_address_payment_required_text.uiLocation: FIO address register select wallet scene, description

placeholders.%1$s: App name (e.g. Edge)

fio_domain_wallet_selection_text.description: Explanation on the wallet selection screen when registering a FIO Domain. It says domains have an annual fee required by the FIO Protocol, not by the app, gives the current cost in FIO, which may change, and asks the user to pick a wallet to pay from.
fio_domain_wallet_selection_text.uiLocation: FIO domain register select wallet scene, description

placeholders.%1$s: App name (e.g. Edge)
placeholders.%2$s: Annual domain cost in FIO, or '-' while loading

fio_address_list.description: Title for a list of the user's FIO addresses (Crypto Handles). No usage was found in the code; meaning is inferred from the key and text.

fio_address_register_form_field_label.description: Label for a FIO Crypto Handle, the human-readable name for receiving crypto. It is the input label in the handle entry modal, the row title in handle settings, and a name inserted into the pending registration title and message.
fio_address_register_form_field_label.uiLocation: FIO address register scene input modal; FIO address settings row; registration pending modal

fio_address_register_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the FIO Crypto Handle row on the registration screen, shown until the user enters a handle name.
fio_address_register_placeholder.uiLocation: FIO address register scene, handle row placeholder

fio_address_register_screen_not_availabl.description: Error text shown under the FIO handle input when the chosen FIO address or domain is already taken and cannot be registered. Also used as the error when registration fails because the name is already registered.

fio_address_register_domain_is_not_publi.description: Error shown when the user tries to register a FIO address on a domain that its owner has not made public, so others cannot register addresses on it.
fio_address_register_domain_is_not_publi.uiLocation: Register FIO Handle scene, validation error

fio_address_register_screen_cant_check.description: Error shown under the FIO handle or domain input when the device is offline, so availability of the name cannot be checked.
fio_address_register_screen_cant_check.uiLocation: Register FIO Handle / Domain scenes, input error message

fio_address_register_default_fio_wallet_.description: Default name given to a FIO wallet that the app creates automatically for the user when registering a FIO handle.

fio_address_register_no_wallet_name.description: Placeholder text shown in the wallet selection row when no FIO wallet has been chosen yet to register the handle or domain with.
fio_address_register_no_wallet_name.uiLocation: Register FIO Handle / Domain scenes, wallet row

fio_address_register_pending.description: Message in a popup after the user pays for a FIO name, explaining that the registration completes once payment is confirmed and that they should check the FIO Names list in a few minutes. The %s is the kind of name being registered.

fio_address_register_metadata_name.description: Payee name saved on the transaction that pays for registering a FIO handle or domain. Appears in the transaction history.

fio_address_register_pay_title.description: Title of a popup telling the user they already registered a free address on the chosen domain, so further registration needs payment.
fio_address_register_pay_title.uiLocation: FIO name confirm scene, modal title

fio_address_register_pay.description: Message in a popup explaining that registering this FIO address requires a payment, before the user is sent to choose a payment wallet.
fio_address_register_pay.uiLocation: FIO name confirm scene, modal message

fio_address_confirm_screen_label.description: Row title on the confirmation screen labeling the FIO address (handle) that is about to be registered.

fio_address_confirm_screen_free_label.description: Value shown for the operation fee when the FIO action costs nothing.

fio_address_confirm_screen_disabled_slid.description: Text shown on the disabled confirmation slider when the user's FIO balance is less than the fee.

fio_address_details_screen_alert_title.description: Title of a popup telling the user their FIO address has been created.
fio_address_details_screen_alert_title.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, alert modal title

fio_address_details_screen_alert_message.description: Message in a popup confirming the user's FIO address is registered and can be used.
fio_address_details_screen_alert_message.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, alert modal message

fio_address_details_screen_alert_button.description: Button in the FIO address created popup that dismisses it so the user can see the address details.
fio_address_details_screen_alert_button.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, alert modal button

fio_address_details_screen_registered.description: Heading on the success screen stating the FIO address has been registered; the address name appears below it.

fio_address_details_screen_expires.description: Label preceding the expiration date of a FIO address or domain. Used as a prefix before a date in lists and success screens and as a row title in domain settings.

fio_address_details_screen_manage_accoun.description: Button on the low/no bundled transactions warning card that opens the screen to buy more bundled transactions and transfer the address.
fio_address_details_screen_manage_accoun.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, warning card button

title_no_bundled_txs.description: Title of a warning card shown when a FIO address has run out of bundled transactions.
title_no_bundled_txs.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, warning card title

title_low_on_bundled_txs.description: Title of a warning card shown when a FIO address is running low on bundled transactions.

fio_address_details_bundled_txs_out_soon.description: Warning card body telling the user they have almost used up the bundled transactions of their FIO handle and can tap to buy more.
fio_address_details_bundled_txs_out_soon.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, warning card body

fio_address_details_no_bundled_txs.description: Warning card body telling the user their FIO handle has no bundled transactions left and they can tap to buy more.
fio_address_details_no_bundled_txs.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, warning card body

fio_address_details_connect_to_wallets.description: Section header prompting the user to choose which of their wallets to link to their FIO handle.
fio_address_details_connect_to_wallets.uiLocation: FIO Address details scene, section header

fio_address_list_screen_button_register.description: Button on the FIO names list that starts registering a new FIO handle.
fio_address_list_screen_button_register.uiLocation: FIO Address list scene, primary button

fio_address_list_domain_register.description: Button to start registering a custom FIO domain, shown on the FIO names list and inside the domain picker modal.
fio_address_list_domain_register.uiLocation: FIO Address list scene button; Domain list modal button

fio_address_list_register_domain.description: Item in the domain picker list that lets the user choose to register a new FIO domain instead of using an existing one.
fio_address_list_register_domain.uiLocation: Domain list modal, new domain item

fio_get_fee_err_msg.description: Error shown when the app cannot retrieve the fee for a FIO operation, such as registering, transferring or renewing.
fio_get_fee_err_msg.uiLocation: FIO action submit, settings scenes and name confirm scene error

fio_get_reg_info_err_msg.description: Error shown when the app fails to get FIO registration information from the server.

fio_get_reg_info_domain_err_msg.description: Error shown when the FIO domain the user entered does not exist.

fio_error_invalid_address.uiLocation: Register FIO Handle scene input error; FIO address validation

uk_deposit_parent_crypto_modal_message_n.description: Message in a modal telling the user they lack enough of the network's native coin to pay the fee for a transaction, and must deposit more. Shown for UK users where buying or swapping is not offered.

placeholders.%1$s: Amount of the native coin required for the fee (rounded number)
placeholders.%2$s: Currency code or denomination name of the fee coin, e.g. ETH

uk_deposit_parent_crypto_modal_message_n.description: Message in a modal telling the user they lack enough of the native coin on a specific network to pay the transaction fee, and must deposit more. Used for UK users when the fee coin is ETH on a non-Ethereum network.

placeholders.%1$s: Amount of the native coin required for the fee (rounded number)
placeholders.%2$s: Currency code or denomination name of the fee coin, e.g. ETH
placeholders.%3$s: Display name of the blockchain network the wallet is on

uk_token_agreement_modal_message.description: Message in an agreement modal explaining that a parent currency is needed to pay mining fees when sending tokens, and that the associated wallet must hold enough of it. UK-compliant variant that tells users to use the Exchange function.

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code of the parent coin used to pay fees, e.g. ETH
placeholders.%2$s: Name of the app (Edge)

redacted_placeholder.description: Row of dots shown instead of a balance amount when the user has hidden their balances for privacy.
redacted_placeholder.uiLocation: Balance card, transaction list top, and fiat amount text (hidden balance)

insufficient_funds_2s.description: Error message shown when the user tries to send but doesn't have enough of a currency, typically the fee currency, on a given network.

placeholders.%1$s: Currency code that is insufficient, e.g. ETH
placeholders.%2$s: Display name of the blockchain network

unexpected_pending_transactions_error.description: Error message saying a transaction cannot be sent because the wallet already has an unconfirmed pending transaction, and the user should wait for it to confirm.
unexpected_pending_transactions_error.uiLocation: Send error message (no current usage found)

pending_transaction_modal_title.description: Title of a modal and warning card telling the user that a pending (unconfirmed) transaction exists in the wallet.
pending_transaction_modal_title.uiLocation: Pending transaction modal title; Send scene warning card title

pending_transaction_modal_message.description: Explains that a pending transaction is blocking a new send, and that the user can wait for confirmation or accelerate (speed up) the pending transaction.
pending_transaction_modal_message.uiLocation: Pending transaction modal body; Send scene warning card body

pending_transaction_modal_go_to_transact.description: Button that takes the user to the details of the pending transaction that is blocking their send.

pending_transactions_confirmed.description: Toast message telling the user that the previously pending transactions have confirmed and they can continue with their send.
pending_transactions_confirmed.uiLocation: Toast after pending transaction modal check

split_from_1s.description: Suffix text added to a new wallet's default name to show which existing wallet it was split from.
split_from_1s.uiLocation: Create wallet name scene, default wallet name

placeholders.%1$s: Name of the source wallet being split

split_description.description: Generic explanation of wallet splitting, which creates new wallets from wallets that already exist. Shown when the type of source wallet is unknown or not covered by a more specific description.
split_description.uiLocation: Create wallet edit name scene, split description

split_description_evm.description: Explains that EVM-compatible networks share the same keys and address, so splitting creates a wallet to manage funds on another network using the existing address.
split_description_evm.uiLocation: Create wallet edit name scene, split description (EVM wallets)

split_description_utxo.description: Explains that blockchain forks create coins on a new chain using the user's existing keys, and that splitting sets up a wallet to access those coins.
split_description_utxo.uiLocation: Create wallet edit name scene, split description (Bitcoin-like wallets)

add_custom_token.description: Button that starts adding a custom token (one not in the built-in list) by entering its contract details.
add_custom_token.uiLocation: Create wallet select crypto scene and wallet list scene, button

choose_custom_token_wallet.description: Title of the wallet selection modal where the user picks which wallet a custom token will be added to.

notifications_pinned.description: Section header for notifications that are pinned at the top of the notification center, above other notifications.

notifications_recent.description: Section header in the notification center above the list of recent notifications that are not pinned. The user sees it when they open the notification center and have recent notifications.

notifications_none.description: Empty-state message in the notification center, shown when there are no pinned or recent notifications. It tells the user they have nothing left to review.

swap.description: Name of the action of exchanging one cryptocurrency for another, used as a title or label for the swap feature (for example a tab, scene title or transaction category). Use the verb or noun that people know from crypto exchange apps.

update_available.description: Title of a modal shown at app launch when a newer version of the app is available to install.

enter_email.description: Title or prompt asking the user to type in their email address. No usage sites were found, so this is inferred from the key and value.

enter_contact_info.description: Header title of a form where the user enters their contact details, such as first name and email. It appears above an optional message and the form fields.

edge_ucation.description: Playful section title for educational cards (guides and tips) on the wallet details screen, shown when the app is Edge. It is a pun combining 'Edge' and 'education', so translators may adapt it creatively.
edge_ucation.uiLocation: Wallet Details scene, education section header

education.description: Generic section title for educational cards (guides and tips) on the wallet details screen, used when the app is not branded Edge.
education.uiLocation: Wallet Details scene, education section header

enter_value.description: Placeholder text in an editable amount tile, shown in place of the crypto amount while no amount has been entered. It prompts the user to type an amount.
enter_value.uiLocation: Editable amount tile, empty amount placeholder

trade_region_select_start_steps.description: Subtitle above a list of four numbered steps on the region selection screen for buying or selling crypto. It introduces the steps for getting started.
trade_region_select_start_steps.uiLocation: Ramp region select scene, subtitle above steps

trade_region_select_step_1.description: First of four steps in the buy/sell getting-started list. It tells the user to select their region so they see options that fit where they live.
trade_region_select_step_1.uiLocation: Ramp region select scene, step 1 text

trade_region_select_step_2.description: Second of four steps in the buy/sell getting-started list. The user creates a quote, meaning a price offer for the purchase or sale.
trade_region_select_step_2.uiLocation: Ramp region select scene, step 2 text

trade_region_select_step_3.description: Third of four steps in the buy/sell getting-started list. The user picks how they will pay, such as bank transfer or card.
trade_region_select_step_3.uiLocation: Ramp region select scene, step 3 text

trade_region_select_step_4.description: Fourth of four steps in the buy/sell getting-started list. The user adds money to their account to complete the purchase.
trade_region_select_step_4.uiLocation: Ramp region select scene, step 4 text

trade_buy_unavailable_title.description: Title of a warning or error saying buying crypto is not available for the chosen combination. Shown in a warning card on the buy/sell scene and as an error title when no provider can give a quote.

trade_buy_unavailable_body_2s.description: Warning message saying the user cannot buy the chosen crypto with the chosen fiat currency right now. Shown in the buy/sell scene's warning card, and may be followed by a suggestion of other currencies.

placeholders.%2$s: Fiat currency code used to pay (e.g. USD)

trade_sell_unavailable_title.description: Title of a warning or error saying selling crypto is not available for the chosen combination. Shown in a warning card on the buy/sell scene and as an error title when no provider can give a quote.
trade_sell_unavailable_title.uiLocation: Ramp create scene, warning card title / quote error title

trade_sell_unavailable_body_1_2s.description: Warning message saying the user cannot sell the chosen crypto for the chosen fiat currency right now. Shown in the buy/sell scene's warning card, and may be followed by a suggestion of other currencies.

placeholders.%1$s: Crypto asset the user wants to sell (e.g. BTC)
placeholders.%2$s: Fiat currency code the user would receive (e.g. USD)

trade_check_fiat_1s.description: Suggestion appended to an unavailable warning, telling the user to try getting quotes in their region's native fiat currencies.

placeholders.%1$s: Comma-separated list of fiat currency codes (e.g. EUR, GBP)

trade_check_fiat_best_quote_body_2s.description: Body of the warning card on the quote selection screen. It says which fiat currency the shown quotes use and lists other currencies that may have more quotes.

trade_create_amount_s.description: Placeholder text for the crypto amount input on the buy/sell scene, naming the asset the amount is for.

trade_create_exchange_rate.description: Label above the exchange rate (price of crypto in fiat) from the best quote on the buy/sell scene.

trade_create_next.description: Primary button on the buy/sell scene that moves the user on to the quote selection step once an amount is entered.

ramp_account_number_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the input field where the user types their bank account number.
ramp_account_number_placeholder.uiLocation: Ramp bank form scene, account number field

ramp_routing_number_placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the input field where the user types their bank routing number (the US ABA number identifying the bank).
ramp_routing_number_placeholder.uiLocation: Ramp bank form scene, routing number field

ramp_account_number_error_min_length_1s.description: Validation error shown under the account number field when the number is too short.
ramp_account_number_error_min_length_1s.uiLocation: Ramp bank form scene, account number field error

placeholders.%1$s: Minimum number of digits required (for example 4)

ramp_routing_number_error_length_1s.description: Validation error shown under the routing number field when it does not have the required number of digits.
ramp_routing_number_error_length_1s.uiLocation: Ramp bank form scene, routing number field error

placeholders.%1$s: Exact number of digits required (for example 9)

string_submit.description: Button label to submit what the user has entered. It is used on the email verification code modal and on the bank details form.
string_submit.uiLocation: Email verification modal and bank form scene, primary button

ramp_bank_routing_title.description: Header title of the scene that shows the bank account the user must send a bank transfer to, in order to buy crypto.
ramp_bank_routing_title.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, header title

ramp_bank_routing_instructions.description: Instruction telling the user to send the exact amount shown to the listed bank account.
ramp_bank_routing_instructions.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, instruction text

ramp_send_amount_label.description: Label above the fiat amount the user must transfer to the bank account. The amount can be copied.
ramp_send_amount_label.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, amount card

ramp_bank_details_section_title.description: Section header above the bank account fields. On the form it groups the fields where the user enters their bank info. On the routing scene it groups the destination bank's details.
ramp_bank_details_section_title.uiLocation: Ramp bank form and bank routing details scenes, section header

ramp_bank_name_label.description: Row title for the name of the bank that will receive the transfer. Its value is shown with a copy button.
ramp_bank_name_label.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, bank name row

ramp_account_number_label.description: Row title for the bank account number to send the transfer to. Its value is shown with a copy button.
ramp_account_number_label.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, account number row

ramp_routing_number_label.description: Row title for the bank routing number (the US ABA number identifying the bank) to send the transfer to. Its value is shown with a copy button.
ramp_routing_number_label.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, routing number row

ramp_bank_routing_warning.description: Warning below the bank details telling the user to double-check all details before making the bank transfer.
ramp_bank_routing_warning.uiLocation: Bank routing details scene, warning text

shortcut_do_not_uninstall_title.description: Title of an app-icon quick action (long-press shortcut) warning users to save their 2FA (two-factor authentication) setup before uninstalling the app. It starts with a warning emoji.
shortcut_do_not_uninstall_title.uiLocation: App icon quick action menu, title

shortcut_do_not_uninstall_subtitle.description: Subtitle of the quick action warning that logging back in requires both 2FA and the user's credentials, so users should not uninstall without them.
shortcut_do_not_uninstall_subtitle.uiLocation: App icon quick action menu, subtitle

shortcut_contact_support_title.description: Title of an app-icon quick action (long-press shortcut) that opens the support contact page.
shortcut_contact_support_title.uiLocation: App icon quick action menu, title

shortcut_contact_support_subtitle.description: Subtitle of the contact support quick action, explaining that it connects the user with the support team.
shortcut_contact_support_subtitle.uiLocation: App icon quick action menu, subtitle

unknown_error_message.description: Generic message shown when the status check on the pending scene fails with an unexpected error.
